facts.fact: A Finance Ministry order of 12 February 2026 requires an individual filing a remote company-existence declaration to create an account on the National Business Register platform using digital identity, an electronic certificate or another legally recognised e-signature or reliable means of verifying identity, and takes effect six months after publication.
